comparison.objective: Feed a press blank to a backstop while limiting and restoring a guard versus commission an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand holds a gravity guard while the other uses a push stick versus tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, relocking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Guard raised no more than 8 cm, blank at backstop, stick withdrawn, and guard lowered versus two repeatable safe stops within stroke and drift limits.
comparison.reason: This duplicate press-feed record remains distinct from the candidate; its tested mechanism is guard-constrained insertion, not dynamic tuning.
